Title: Roadmap / PoC verification

Description:
This issue tracks the Proof-of-Concept (PoC) validation for the OpenClaw Optimization Agent. The goal is to validate the minimal pipeline end-to-end and produce reproducible example artifacts.

Acceptance criteria:
- `npm run run` produces `reports/last-run.json` and a console summary
- The repository contains example report data (committed)
- Document steps to reproduce and expected outputs in `docs/`
- Create follow-up issues for gaps identified during PoC

Notes:
- Assigned to: @iqki
- Priority: High
